The '''C-8 life support system''' was a life support system manufactured by [[Corellstand/Legends|Corellstand]]. The [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] was equipped with a C-8 life support system,<ref name="SWS" /> which was standard issue for [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 light freighters]]. C-8s could be restructured for any type of pressurized gas.<ref name="MF3D">''[[Star Wars: Millennium Falcon: A 3-D Owner's Guide]]''</ref>
